[[File:OrnateBracelet.jpg|200px|thumb|A platinum and gold bracelet]]
'''Platinum''' was a strategically valuable metal element worth fifteen to twenty-five [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per gram. It was rumored that an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] made entirely of platinum existed in the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]], known as "[[Kerane's Folly/Legends|Kerane's Folly]]."

When captured for his bounty, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] found himself unable to make a larger counter-offer, unless, he mused, he suddenly stumbled upon a mountain of platinum.

The metal was also found in [[smoker]]s on [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] and on the planet [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]].<ref name="Goroth: Slave of the Empire">''[[Goroth: Slave of the Empire]]''</ref>

{{Science-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Wikipedia:Platinum|Platinum]] is the most valuable metal on the market in the real world.
